title: ConfigArgParse配置入口工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：对单个配置输入实施可诊断重复键政策；让零依赖JSON配置真正驱动参数动作；让每次参数解析产出隔离的结果与来源快照；无业务副作用地发现本次默认配置来源；按预声明文件扩展名分派真实配置解析器；把明确JSON层级映射为真实参数命名空间。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Implement DefaultConfigFileParser(*, duplicates="last") with last/warn/error for exact case-sensitive keys within one parsed stream. Keep the old last-value policy by default. Warn/error diagnostics identify the source and first/current 1-based physical lines without values. Blank/comment lines count; repeated lists are whole-value replacement. Parsing separate streams never shares duplicate state; normal cross-file precedence and CLI override stay unchanged. Reject unknown policies and preserve all existing syntax and serialization.

Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Add ArgumentParser.discover_config_files() for declared default_config_files only. Return ordered fresh records matching existing glob expansion and duplicate source order: path records contain kind,index,path,exists; unmatched declarations produce exists=false; provider records contain only kind="provider",index,executed=false. Support PathLike and expanduser with path-before-callable precedence. Do not open files, invoke providers, inspect their repr, run argument actions or mutate last parse/source state.
